senses.gloss: (Shaf. of עָמַם) to make dull, stupefy.—Part. pass. מְשׁוּעֲמָם; f. מְשׁוּעֲמֶמֶת.

units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10">Num. R. s. 10<sup>8</sup></cite> <he>יצא כל דעתו נִשְׁתַּעַמְמוּ כל הכליות וכ׳</he> all his mind is gone (in drunkenness), the kidneys (seat of deliberation) are entirely dulled, and his heart (reason) is disordered &c.
